body:
Quotable:

 Women, I have to tell you that I believe we also should all KNOW OUR PLACE. Be it as a teacher, local business owner, or corporate world traveler. Be it as a cook for the local homeless shelter, someone who sponsors a child from a humanitarian organization, or someone who physically moves to the soil of Africa. Be it as a co – leader in your home or a single parent and the capable head of your household. Be it as a volunteer in your church’s children’s ministry, a skilled teacher, or the Ordained Pastor of the church.

  

 More here:  https://www.facebook.com/melissa.greene.3998/posts/10154584606097775
